build_blip_retrieval_model: build a BLIP retrieval model with vision and text backbone configs for image-text matching
extract_feat_image_text: extract image and text features from the BLIP retrieval model using extract_feat method
compute_loss_blip: compute contrastive and image-text matching losses for a batch of images and texts
predict_i2t_t2i: predict image-to-text and text-to-image retrieval scores using the predict method
all_gather_concat_tensor: gather and concatenate tensors of varying sizes across distributed GPU ranks
